title: App definition
sub: Updates live · pages can be edited as JSON
noMatchHint: Try a page, function, table or a JSON pointer like /data/tables.
banner: Advanced view of the same definition the visual editors and Studio AI change. It updates live; a whole page can be edited as JSON, everything else is read-only here. Records, files and run history are never part of it.
missingHint: It was renamed or deleted since you opened it.
truncated: Showing the first {n} lines. Select a smaller item in the tree to see all of it.

edit.label: JSON of the {page} page
edit.hint: Applied edits are unsaved until you save, like any other change.
edit.banner: You are editing this page as JSON. Apply checks it first; the page id must stay the same.

issue.notObject: The page must be a JSON object.
issue.noParent: Block “{block}” points at “{parent}”, which isn’t on this page.
issue.notContainer: Block “{block}” sits in “{parent}”, but a {type} can’t hold blocks.
issue.slot: Block “{block}” uses slot {slot}, but its container has {count} cell(s).
issue.noTable: Block “{block}” reads table “{table}”, which doesn’t exist.
issue.noField: Block “{block}” shows field “{field}”, which table “{table}” doesn’t have.
